spans.s: Arbuda, m. (nt. in Ud? = Pali Abbuda), n. of a hell, acc. to Mvy and Dharmas a cold one (so in Pali, CPD): Mvy 〔4929〕; Dharmas 〔122〕; Divy 〔67.22〕; 〔138.7〕; Av 〔i.4.9〕 etc.; Ud 〔viii.5〕 arbudāni, gender app. influenced by sahasrāṇi of prec. line, which as Chakravarti assumes may be understood here, i.e. arbudāni short for ˚da-sahasrāṇi?
